## Problems, failure modes and limitations

- [statement] The mongodb/atlas-billing README marks its older Realm-based billing dashboard solution deprecated and unmaintained because Charts now offers native billing dashboards; its code remains an example for custom ingestion. (low confidence) (verified as of 2026-10-24) — https://github.com/mongodb/atlas-billing · keywords: Atlas Charts billing dashboards

## Facts and statements

- [statement] Billing dashboards provide prebuilt views of organization spending, largest spenders, and spending by instance size, project, cluster, category, and SKU. Teams can customize them for cost analysis. (high confidence) — https://www.mongodb.com/docs/charts/dashboards/manage-dashboards/billing-dashboards.md · keywords: Atlas Charts billing dashboards · also: https://www.mongodb.com/docs/atlas/architecture/current/billing-data.md, https://www.mongodb.com/docs/charts/dashboards.md, https://www.mongodb.com/docs/charts/dashboards/manage-dashboards/billing-dashboards/
- [statement] Resource tags in billing data can drive additional charts and dashboard filters, including allocation by team and environment. (medium confidence) — https://www.mongodb.com/docs/atlas/architecture/current/billing-data.md · keywords: Atlas Charts billing dashboards · also: https://www.mongodb.com/company/blog/product-release-announcements/exploring-new-security-billing-customization-features-in-atlas-charts, https://www.mongodb.com/docs/charts/release-notes.md
- [statement] Manually refreshing a chart re-queries that chart's backing data source. A billing dashboard's initial ingestion uses the Invoices API to load the last twelve months of billing data into the selected deployment and database; Atlas then ingests billing data daily. (low confidence) (verified as of 2026-10-24) — https://www.mongodb.com/docs/charts/dashboards/manage-dashboards/billing-dashboards.md · keywords: Atlas Charts billing dashboards · also: https://www.mongodb.com/docs/charts/dashboards/manage-dashboards/billing-dashboards/, https://www.mongodb.com/docs/charts/dashboards/view-dashboard-data/dashboard-refresh.md
- [statement] The dashboard history window is twelve months. Enabling linked invoices on an existing ingestion brings three months of linked history; a new ingestion brings twelve months. (medium confidence) (verified as of 2026-10-14) — https://www.mongodb.com/docs/charts/dashboards/manage-dashboards/billing-dashboards.md · keywords: Atlas Charts billing dashboards · also: https://www.mongodb.com/company/blog/product-release-announcements/exploring-new-security-billing-customization-features-in-atlas-charts, https://www.mongodb.com/docs/charts/dashboards/manage-dashboards/billing-dashboards/
- [statement] Invoice corrections propagate only for invoices incurred within the preceding three months, after the next scheduled ingestion. Older invoice corrections therefore require particular care during reconciliation. (low confidence) (verified as of 2026-10-14) — https://www.mongodb.com/docs/charts/dashboards/manage-dashboards/billing-dashboards.md · keywords: Atlas Charts billing dashboards · also: https://www.mongodb.com/docs/charts/dashboards/manage-dashboards/billing-dashboards/
- [statement] Creating a dashboard requires Project Data Access Read/Write or higher. Setup asks for organization API keys and names Organization Billing Admin and Organization Billing Viewer access; verify the exact accepted role combination before provisioning. (low confidence) (verified as of 2026-10-14) — https://www.mongodb.com/docs/charts/dashboards/manage-dashboards/billing-dashboards.md · keywords: Atlas Charts billing dashboards
- [statement] Default billing dashboard filter fields are name, cluster, category, and sku. All standard dashboard and chart features also apply. (low confidence) (verified as of 2026-10-14) — https://www.mongodb.com/docs/charts/dashboards/manage-dashboards/billing-dashboards.md · keywords: Atlas Charts billing dashboards
- [statement] For another organization, setup accepts its organization ID and API keys. For cross-organization billing, configure the paying organization and choose whether to ingest linked invoices. (medium confidence) (verified as of 2026-10-14) — https://www.mongodb.com/docs/charts/dashboards/manage-dashboards/billing-dashboards.md · keywords: Atlas Charts billing dashboards · also: https://www.mongodb.com/company/blog/product-release-announcements/exploring-new-security-billing-customization-features-in-atlas-charts
- [statement] MongoDB positions Charts billing dashboards as a customization option beyond Cost Explorer; the built-in dashboard was publicly announced in October 2023. (medium confidence) — https://www.mongodb.com/company/blog/product-release-announcements/view-analyze-your-monthly-mongodb-atlas-usage-cost-explorer · keywords: Atlas Charts billing dashboards · also: https://www.mongodb.com/products/updates/create-and-customize-your-own-billing-dashboard-with-atlas-charts/, https://www.mongodb.com/docs/charts/dashboards.md
- [statement] Release notes record a billing-ingestion payload-size fix in v1.45.0 and an older-invoice missing-line-items fix in v1.47.0. These are historical defects, not evidence that current dashboards still have those failures. (low confidence) — https://www.mongodb.com/docs/charts/release-notes.md · keywords: Atlas Charts billing dashboards
- [statement] A January 2024 community answer directs a user seeking MongoDB expense visualizations to the native Charts billing-dashboard documentation. (low confidence) — https://www.mongodb.com/community/forums/t/getting-mongodbs-billing-details/260172 · keywords: Atlas Charts billing dashboards
- [statement] Billing dashboards provide prebuilt Atlas spending charts and can be customized after billing-data ingestion. (high confidence) — https://www.mongodb.com/docs/charts/dashboards/manage-dashboards/billing-dashboards/ · keywords: Atlas Charts billing dashboards · also: https://www.mongodb.com/docs/atlas/architecture/current/billing-data.md, https://www.manning.com/preview/mongodb-in-action-third-edition/chapter-19
- [statement] Tags support custom allocation charts and dashboard filters, including team and environment views; linked organizations can be filtered by organizationId. (medium confidence) (verified as of 2026-10-19) — https://www.mongodb.com/docs/charts/dashboards/manage-dashboards/billing-dashboards/ · keywords: Atlas Charts billing dashboards · also: https://www.mongodb.com/company/blog/product-release-announcements/exploring-new-security-billing-customization-features-in-atlas-charts
- [statement] Creation requires Project Data Access Read/Write. Setup asks for organization API keys, a target deployment and database; default filter fields are name, cluster, category and sku. (low confidence) (verified as of 2026-10-19) — https://www.mongodb.com/docs/charts/dashboards/manage-dashboards/billing-dashboards/ · keywords: Atlas Charts billing dashboards
